rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dropper_XLSM {
    meta:
        description = "Detects XLSM files containing Cobalt Strike beacon payloads"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:AMBER"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 72 00 } // '.rcdr' string common in beacon configs
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" ascii
        $c2_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{" ascii
        $sched_task = "WindowsUpdate" ascii
    condition:
        filename matches /\\.xlsm$/i and all of ($beacon_config, $http_get, $c2_mutex)
}

rule Emotet_Dropper_XLSM {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Emotet-laced XLSM files via embedded VBA auto-execution patterns"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6789012345678abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01"
    strings:
        $vba_autoopen = "Auto_Open" fullword ascii
        $vba_document_open = "Document_Open" fullword ascii
        $shell_call = "Shell " wide
        $powershell_exec = "powershell.exe" wide
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x504B and all of ($vba*)
}

    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beacon patterns in Office documents"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"

    condition:
        all of ($beacon*) or ($injection_api and $payload_marker)
}
